Your holdings: QQQ (-4.53%), SMH (-15.65%), and QQQI (-6.77%) are all flagged "SELL" and are near their stops. Your leveraged SOXL (-55.16%) and SPAL (-58.01%) are deep in the red; remember margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Apple and Amazon's earnings after the bell. Also, monitor how the positive chip news from Microsoft's earnings translates to your chip holdings.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk, especially with your leveraged positions and upcoming big tech earnings.
plays: Respect stops on QQQ (670), SMH (540), and QQQI (52) to protect capital.
Review SOXL and SPAL; their deep losses and leveraged nature amplify margin risk. Consider adjusting stops or trimming.
